limits: receives the existing caster map; does not add missing terrain casters
plane solar-refraction interface at mean sea level

glintAA.model: pixel normal variance plus statistical 1/120 s temporal slope variance; only direct-sun NDF

windSea.frequencyShape: JONSWAP-shaped, gamma3.3, log-k importance weighted; no fetch/growth solve

linear superposition, no overturning or full nonlinear wave interactions
